name: Cho-Z Spriggan
description: The ultimate customizable tactical beast. Cho-Z Spriggan utilizes its internal Cho-Z Wings to prevent bursts while adapting its spin style to completely counter any challenger.

ability.name: Zeta Overdrive
ability.description: Cho-Z Spriggan overclock its adaptive tip to maximum output. vs Attack: 50 HP shield with 20% reflect (20 true dmg). vs Defense/Stamina: +35 ATK for 3 turns + silence for 1 turn. vs Balance: both 30 HP shield AND +20 ATK. All variants grant defense-pierce on the next Attack.

special_move.name: Cho-Z Upper
special_move.description: Spriggan extends its hidden crimson wings and delivers a massive, un-burstable upward strike that launches the enemy into the air!
flavour_texts: 🛡️ **Hit 1** — The Cho-Z Wings lock into place!
